Ruled at the hundred-twentieth: a VOICED NO is an establishment cited to the customer's words and reds immediately at any stage; NEVER ESTABLISHED is absence, and absence is not evidence, so it reds only once process state says it should have been known by now. Unknown budget at stage 1 is quiet and lawful; unknown budget at stage 4 is a deal-killer reading "unknown past stage". One row per question code, seeded by us and ORG-OVERRIDABLE - the same shape the seventy-seventh ruled for the buyer-role ranks. IT IS NOT THE VENDOR'S STAGE GATE: ALTF__Qualification__c gates STAGE MOVEMENT on qualifier completion, which is the vendor's job; this gates RED-FLAG TIMING on assessment questions. Two gates, two jobs (122nd, item 2).
